comment: There is no published source: sourceUrl is empty in the installed plugin.json and the maker's repository holds only the manuals and two changelogs. Everything here comes from the v2.1.0 manual PDF, the installed panel image res/MiniTruffles.png and the census names. Load Sample is a parameter (index 22) with no widget on the panel, so it has no line and no tag; it is reachable only as the Load Sample item on the panel menu. The trigger, flip, active and reset jacks latch against 2V rather than the 1V a button uses, so a 1V trigger does not fire them. The Mode switch prints Backwards where the manual page writes Backward.
